recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7587; future work on Extension Pack laterality or broader BodyStructure modeling should proceed under newer issue keys.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO DSTU1 issue asking to simplify Observation.bodySite by removing the CodeableConcept-or-BodySite-resource choice, moving BodySite resource references to standard extension handling via FHIR-6253, and creating laterality extension support.
initial_application: No current-source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7587. The related FHIR-3600/#3600 work first added Observation.bodySite[x] as CodeableConcept|Reference(BodySite); commit 4e55d97ce3 for #6253 then removed Reference(BodySite) from Observation.bodySite and made it a plain CodeableConcept for OO resources.
additional_context: Observation and BodyStructure are active current-build resources. Current Observation source has deprecated Observation.bodySite as CodeableConcept, Observation.bodyStructure as CodeableReference(BodyStructure), and obs-8 enforcing mutual exclusion. Later FHIR-34894 and FHIR-53203 explain the direct bodyStructure element and CodeableReference/deprecation model, while the FHIR Extension Pack contains the bodySite and observation-structureLaterality extension definitions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core source no longer contains Observation.bodySite[x] or Reference(BodySite), and the current bodyStructure plus extension-pack model preserves the intended support for detailed body location and laterality without reintroducing the over-complicated choice.
